title: The Loose Safehouse
author: Cyrus Nystrom
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
